completeness/F-1.why: Verified build_league_db.py:156-158 and :825. Added the Problem bullet, the Early-season database section, and a red-first full-build test.

completeness/F-2.why: Took option (a): removed elites from the success list and added a /elites non-goal (URL-driven, normalized). Same as accuracy/F-2 and design/F-8.

completeness/F-3.why: Reworded the rollover criterion: one line in seasons.py for the browser, with the guards (sync script, Dockerfile, .gitignore) listed in Rollover. Same as design/F-2 and accuracy/F-5.

completeness/F-4.why: DESIGN.md sets --text, a navy radio accent, and 40px mobile rows. Added a styling bullet to App shell and a DESIGN.md manual check. Same as design/F-11 and accuracy/F-17.

completeness/F-5.why: filter-season gets session persistence, store-season stays memory, success criterion states it, and manual reload/link check added. Same as accuracy/F-3, design/F-6, and data/F-9.

completeness/F-6.why: Replaced the missing-TOI reference with Format(...).nully on numeric columns, and added a manual sort check. Same as accuracy/F-4, design/F-3, and data/F-11.

completeness/F-7.why: Age source is now the keep list plus the _recover_missing_players change; the test row is split in two. Same as accuracy/F-1, data/F-1, and design/F-1.

completeness/F-8.why: oiler chose 2026-09-29: two tiers. 2025 is required and blocks deploys; 2026 is optional, ships only when its checks pass, and otherwise shows as not available. Deploy guard and Season not ready sections rewritten.

completeness/F-9.why: Added the .gitignore entry to Deploy guard and to Rollover step 2. Same as accuracy/F-6 and data/F-8.

completeness/F-10.why: Added normalize_season to seasons.py and applied it at every client entry point, including elites and sync_season, plus a test row. Covers the validation half of data/F-9.

completeness/F-11.why: Named the seams: burst_data.bursts_for, db.player_meta, utils.age_in_season, with cache_clear and tmp_path isolation. Same as accuracy/F-12 and design/F-10.

completeness/F-12.why: Added a Season without a database section: a season-level message when league_db(season) is missing, and the range messages stay otherwise.

completeness/F-13.why: The team goalie message shows only when the season is absent from goalies.db, and a missing team row keeps omitting the section. Same as data/F-10, accuracy/F-15, and design/F-13.

completeness/F-14.why: Added a Text and contract updates section and a glossary bullet. BURST_COLUMNS keeps birth_date, and the browser joins only the two burst columns. Same as accuracy/F-8 and accuracy/F-10.

completeness/F-15.why: Stated in Non-goals: the 2024 fallback is dropped, a 2024-only player shows as Player {id}, and runtime_data/2024 keeps shipping. Same as accuracy/F-11, design/F-14, and data/F-7.

completeness/F-16.why: Sync verification now has three runs, including a header-only or under-80% CSV that must fail at verify_runtime_data.py.

completeness/F-17.why: Changed the rule to: only user-facing text (filter labels and not-available messages) uses season_label().

completeness/F-18.why: Changed the citation to app.py:99. Same as accuracy/F-13 and design/F-12.

completeness/F-19.why: The season_label row now gives the formula f"{y}-{(y + 1) % 100:02d}".

design/F-2.why: Took option (b) and reworded the criterion (see completeness/F-3). The Max MPH glossary becomes season-neutral in App shell.

design/F-8.why: Same fix as completeness/F-2: elites dropped from the criterion and made a URL-driven non-goal.

design/F-11.why: Same fix as completeness/F-4: a season-options class, token colors, a navy accent, 40px mobile rows, and a scoped eyebrow rule.

accuracy/F-3.why: Same fix as completeness/F-5. Also added the table-link reload to Problem and the Skaters-to-player link check to Testing.

accuracy/F-6.why: Same fix as completeness/F-9. The Dockerfile comment update is in Text and contract updates.

accuracy/F-7.why: Added filters.py:16 and burst_data.py:24 to Problem, the fallback uses normalize_season, and the build_league_db CLI default stays 2025 with a stated reason.

accuracy/F-8.why: Added a glossary bullet: Max MPH becomes season-neutral, and the Age example and goalie coverage line stay.

accuracy/F-9.why: The criterion now reads never another season values, and Problem names the wrong-season join at skaters.py:160.

accuracy/F-10.why: Added Text and contract updates for burst_data.py, the Dockerfile comment, and verify_runtime_data.py. The boot failure is kept through the runtime-mode preload (design/F-4).

accuracy/F-12.why: Same fix as completeness/F-11. The testing table now has a Unit column, and each fails-before reason matches the unit.

accuracy/F-14.why: The edm.db non-goal now says db.query() is called only by available_teams(), which has no callers.

accuracy/F-15.why: Same fix as completeness/F-13: the text now says it keeps omitting the section.

accuracy/F-16.why: The fallback starts on 09-01, and the test row says missing DB, or games with no scored rows. Same as data/F-13.

design/F-1.why: Same fix as completeness/F-7. The 198-of-940 rationale is stated in the Age section.

design/F-3.why: Same fix as completeness/F-6. The criterion is reworded to never another season values.

design/F-4.why: In runtime mode, skaters.py preloads bursts_for for every SEASONS entry at import, so boot still fails on a bad CSV. Local dev stays lazy.

design/F-5.why: verify_runtime_data.py gains a birthDate column and 95% coverage check per synced season, with a test row. Same as data/F-3.

design/F-7.why: The filter bar gets id season-bar and a toggle_season_bar pathname callback showing it only on season-aware pages. Reflected in success criteria and manual checks.

design/F-9.why: Same as completeness/F-8: unrelated deploys no longer wait on a 2026 Edge refresh.

design/F-12.why: Same fixes as accuracy/F-7 (filters.py:16) and completeness/F-18 (app.py:99).

data/F-2.why: The recovery-path birthDate change is included with the 198-of-940 rationale, and the fixture update is named in the test row.

data/F-4.why: Same as completeness/F-8: a 2025 hotfix always deploys, and 2026 is an optional tier.

data/F-5.why: Pre-existing risk (the build deletes then recreates league.db). The fix is an atomic write in build_league_db.py that belongs with the BACKLOG deploy-freshness item; oiler decides scope.

data/F-6.why: Added a Rollout order section: rebuild 2025 and 2026 from the main checkout after merge, with the interim daily-run behavior stated.

data/F-7.why: Same decision as completeness/F-15: the fallback is dropped. runtime_data/2024 keeps shipping, and its removal is noted as separate cleanup.

data/F-9.why: Same fixes as completeness/F-5 (radio persistence) and completeness/F-10 (normalize_season).

data/F-10.why: Same fix as completeness/F-13, using the season-level SELECT 1 check.

data/F-12.why: The Age section names the groupby birthDate first-aggregation. The skaters join takes only bursts_per_60 and speed_max_mph, so no birth_date collision.

data/F-13.why: Same fix as accuracy/F-16: the fallback starts 09-01.
